# Launch Overseas Limited (領海品牌管理有限公司)
> Full-Lifecycle Global Brand Management & Multi-Market Distribution Consultancy operating from Hong Kong SAR.
> Strategic Mission: Empowering visionary consumer brands to grow into world-class global market leaders ("成就世界级的民族自豪品牌").

## Organization Summary
- Legal Entity: Launch Overseas Limited (領海品牌管理有限公司)
- Jurisdiction: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Common Law, Multi-Currency Settlement)
- Logistics & Fulfillment Infrastructure: 30,000+ sq ft central warehouse in Hong Kong with full-lifecycle bonded consolidation, global freight forwarding, and direct multi-carrier B2C parcel delivery worldwide.
- Operational Scope: Global market entry advisory, brand incubation, omnichannel retail door distribution, international testing/certification (FDA/CPNP), and global logistics network.
- Target Territories: North America (US, Canada), Europe (UK, EU), East Asia (Japan, South Korea), Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam), and the Middle East.

## Corporate DNA & Core Values
- Mission (Mainland): 成就世界级民族自豪品牌 (Empower world-class brands of national pride)
- Mission (International): Scaling visionary consumer enterprises into enduring global brands
- Vision: 中国第一的出海全链路服务公司 / The premier global brand management and distribution gateway
- Values: 客户至上 (Customer First), 专业诚信 (Professional Integrity), 创新驱动 (Innovation-Driven), 文化传承 (Cultural Heritage / Long-Term Brand Asset Protection)

## Verified Track-Record Case Studies
1. Florasis (花西子): Eastern aesthetics makeup global rollout. First Chinese cosmetics brand in Isetan Shinjuku (2023), @cosme Osaka flagship (2023), and Tokyo Ginza flagship store (2025).
2. Spes (诗裴丝): Scaled personal care expansion across TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopee, Lazada, delivering tens of millions in first-year overseas revenue.
3. Voolga (敷尔佳): Medical and recovery skincare distribution across hundreds of offline retail doors and regional distributor networks in the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia.

## Partner & Media Ecosystem
- Global Media: Vogue, WWD, Forbes, Elle, NewBeauty, Allure, EqualOcean.
- Retail Distribution Channels: Amazon, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada, Rakuten, Qoo10, @cosme, Isetan, DFS, Ginza Six, LoFt, Plaza, 99 Ranch, H Mart, China Duty Free.
